definitions.explanation: A track and field event in which athletes throw a heavy metal ball as far as possible.

examples.japanese: {砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧。
examples.english: I won first place in shot put.

examples.japanese: {砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧だ。
examples.english: Shot put is an event that requires strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日本記録|にほんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: She holds the Japanese record in shot put.

notes:
{砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ is a track and field throwing event. The {砲丸|ほうがん} (shot) is a heavy metal ball that weighs 7.26 kg for men and 4 kg for women.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (shot put athlete)
- {砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to set a record in shot put)
